nodes.description: mapping(address => Wallet[]) public wallets; stores wallet owners, allowance, logs and transactions
constructor ibaMultisig() public, empty body
getWalletId(address creator, bytes32 name) external view, loops over wallets
getOwners(address creator, uint id) external view, returns owners array
getTxnNum(address creator, uint id) external view, returns transactions length
getTxn(address creator, uint walletId, uint id) external view, returns transaction fields
getLogsNum(address creator, uint id) external view, returns logs length
getLog(address creator, uint id, uint logId) external view, returns log sender and amount
createWallet(uint approvals, address[] owners, bytes32 name) external payable, creates wallet for msg.sender
topBalance(address creator, uint id) external payable, increases allowance and appends log
submitTransaction(address creator, address destination, uint walletId, uint value, bytes data) onlyOwner external
confirmTransaction(address creator, uint walletId, uint txId) onlyOwner external, pushes msg.sender to confirmed
executeTxn(address creator, uint walletId, uint txId) onlyOwner external, performs external call then updates state
modifier onlyOwner(address creator, uint walletId) verifying msg.sender is in owners array
msg.sender used inside onlyOwner modifier ownership check
msg.sender used as key when creating wallet
msg.sender recorded as log sender in topBalance
msg.sender stored as transaction creator in submitTransaction
msg.sender pushed into transaction confirmed array in confirmTransaction
dest.call.value(val)(dat) low-level external call before state update in executeTxn
wallet.allowance = wallet.allowance - txn.value unchecked subtraction in executeTxn
wallets[creator][id].allowance += msg.value unchecked addition in topBalance
uint approvals parameter of createWallet
address[] owners parameter of createWallet
bytes32 name parameter of createWallet
address creator parameter of topBalance
uint id parameter of topBalance
address creator parameter of submitTransaction
address destination parameter of submitTransaction
uint walletId parameter of submitTransaction
uint value parameter of submitTransaction
bytes data parameter of submitTransaction
address creator parameter of confirmTransaction
uint walletId parameter of confirmTransaction
uint txId parameter of confirmTransaction
address creator parameter of executeTxn
uint walletId parameter of executeTxn
uint txId parameter of executeTxn
uint currentLen = wallets[msg.sender].length++ in createWallet
uint loglen log index in topBalance
bool f duplicate-confirmation flag in confirmTransaction
address dest = txn.destination in executeTxn
uint val = txn.value in executeTxn
bytes memory dat = txn.data passed to external call in executeTxn

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owners inside the onlyOwner modifier
onlyOwner guards submitTransaction execution
onlyOwner guards confirmTransaction execution
onlyOwner guards executeTxn execution
msg.sender is the wallet creator and lookup key in createWallet

msg.sender stored as transaction creator in submitTransaction
msg.sender pushed into txn.confirmed in confirmTransaction
createWallet writes a new Wallet into the wallets mapping
topBalance writes allowance and logs into the wallets mapping
msg.value flows into the unchecked allowance addition
unchecked allowance arithmetic mutates wallets storage
executeTxn reaches the low-level external call with attacker-controlled destination and data
executeTxn performs the unchecked allowance subtraction after the call
allowance subtraction writes back into the wallets mapping
external call may re-enter executeTxn before txn.status and allowance are updated
external call may re-enter submitTransaction while allowance state is stale
external call may re-enter confirmTransaction and shift approval state
